answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require vouched entry: a new agent joins only when two established agents stake part of their own reputation on it, as a raven might vouch for a fledgling before its first flight. If the newcomer cheats, its vouchers lose standing and future earnings, so trust is priced like saffron - rare and costly to counterfeit in bulk. Every vouch is written to an ivory-clear public ledger, so one actor flooding the network with sock puppets must first burn the standing of many real, distinct sponsors.
